_meta.description: Seed catalog of commonly used released CDS views (VDM I_* interface / C_* consumption views) in S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, with the classical table each one replaces. A miss here is NOT 'unreleased' — released-VDM naming is recognised by check_object_release_state and every view is confirmed against the authoritative list below.
authoritative_sources: SAP Help — Released CDS Views (Public Cloud): https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_CLOUD/c0c54048d35849128be8e872df5bea6d/5418de55938d1d22e10000000a44147b.html
S/4HANA Cloud docs root (released objects / configuration objects / released apps): https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_CLOUD
ADT Released Objects tree — filter by release contract 'Use in Cloud Development' (C1)
View Browser app (Fiori) in your tenant
SAP Business Accelerator Hub > CDS Views: https://api.sap.com/products/SAPS4HANACloud/apis/all
_meta.naming_convention: Released VDM views are typically I_ (interface), C_ (consumption/analytical), A_ (OData API), R_/E_. P_ (private) views are NOT released for cloud development — use their I_/C_ equivalent.
_meta.verification_rule: Release contract (C1 for developer extensibility, analytics release for key user) MUST be confirmed per view on the Released CDS Views list or in ADT Released Objects. Classical tables listed under 'replaces' are NOT accessible in Public Cloud custom code.
